title: Learn Dart through the pure timer engine
description: After verifying the Flutter environment, learn core Dart concepts by implementing and testing pure Lookaway timer rules before introducing Flutter UI or Android service behavior.
assignee: Human learner with AI agent support
acceptance_criteria: Explain Dart values, types, functions, collections, null safety, and enums used in the timer implementation.
Implement timer transitions as UI-independent Dart logic with timestamp-derived countdown behavior.
Add focused tests for focus expiry, break completion, pause/resume, and due-break behavior.
Compare behavior with the existing TypeScript timer and document differences or unverified assumptions.
Record learner practice separately from agent implementation; do not claim mastery without learner demonstration.
test_requirements: Run flutter analyze and flutter test in flutter_app after FLUTTER-001 establishes the toolchain.
Do not claim Android device verification for pure unit tests.
